body:
> A mouseover event to trigger the empty query is probably a better approach.

what about mobile?

> Currently instantjs fires a search with an empty input on page load. It would be great to have some sort of switch or, even better, a character threshold parameter with a reasonable default value (e.g. Don't fire a search request for less than three characters) like Typeahead.js does.

One of the goal of instantsearch and Algolia is to be able to give meaningful results at the first keystroke, thanks to custom ranking (popularity) and speed!

Is it a better idea to only trigger after 3 characters? I am not sure, now that I am used to Algolia I expect all search engines to react at the first keystroke (if they can give good results).

As for this issue @proudlygeek is it a requirement? If so we could add an option to the searchBox widget to only trigger searches after the third character. But really we must ask ourselves: will it be a good UX?
